faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR CIRCOT SRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position at ICAR CIRCOT is 07 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the SRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's degree in Agriculture, Agriculture Engineering, any other Engineering, Agri-business, Finance, Marketing, or Agri-Economics. For basic sciences, a Master's degree with NET qualification and 2 years of research experience is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the SRF role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the SRF position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview, which may be conducted in a hybrid mode, followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the ICAR CIRCOT located?
faq.answer: ICAR Central Institute for Research on Cotton Technology (ICAR CIRCOT) is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 400019.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Senior Research Fellow (SRF) is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required for the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs with their application.
